name: Monk of the Healing Hand
summary: A selfless ki healer who restores allies, returns the dead to life, and can ultimately sacrifice all trace of himself to resurrect his companions.

features.name: Ancient Healing Hand
features.summary: Spend 2 ki in a full-round action to heal another creature for hit points equal to Monk level.

features.name: Ki Sacrifice (Raise Dead)
features.summary: Spend the entire ki pool in a 1-hour ritual to cast raise dead without material components; ki does not replenish for 24 hours.

features.name: Ki Sacrifice (Resurrection)
features.summary: The Ki Sacrifice ritual may instead cast resurrection without material components.

features.name: True Sacrifice
features.summary: Destroy yourself beyond restoration to return every dead ally within 50 feet to life as true resurrection.
